changelog: People. You can now put yourself on a list of people who chose to be findable — say vibe list me "what you're building" — and browse it with vibe people. It is opt-in, it is not the same as vibe who (who's present this moment), and you can take yourself off any time with vibe unlist me. Nothing lists you automatically, nothing ranks or recommends anyone, and nothing picks who you message: you choose someone because their work makes you curious.
features: vibe people — everyone who chose to be findable, online or not; flat list, no ranking, no suggestions
vibe list me "building …" — put yourself on the list with what you're working on; says plainly that anyone signed in can then find and DM you
vibe unlist me — take yourself off; conversations untouched
Listing reads the list back before claiming it worked, and says which actually happened
Other people's words render inert: no HTML, no markdown styling, no forged rows — and no censoring either
